recognize_zh: 組織切片中，脂肪空隙之間由密集成片的漿細胞取代正常造血，細胞核偏位、染色質呈車輪狀並有核周淡染區，符合骨髓廣泛漿細胞浸潤。
features: Diffuse sheets of monotonous plasmacytoid cells replacing marrow between fat spaces
Round eccentric nuclei with clumped, cartwheel-like chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear clearing (hof)
Nuclear detail limited by section thickness and magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow section shows diffuse, packed sheets of plasma cells occupying the intertrabecular space between residual adipocytes. The cells have round eccentric nuclei with clumped chromatin, small nucleoli, and moderate cytoplasm with perinuclear clearing. Normal hematopoietic elements are markedly reduced. Findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by a plasma cell neoplasm, compatible with plasma cell leukemia in the appropriate peripheral blood context; CD138 and kappa/lambda staining are recommended to confirm clonality.

ddx.vs: LPL has a mixture of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells, and mast cells with CD20-positive B cells rather than pure plasma cell sheets.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MZL shows a predominant CD20-positive B-cell population with nodular or intrasinusoidal pattern and only a minor plasma cell component.
Reactive plasma cells are interstitial and perivascular, not in sheets, and are polytypic.
